messages.author: 889f180f2b4f0e97
messages.subject: Order of variables in plot_profiles
parts:
Hi team,

I'm relatively new to tidyLPA and R in general, so this might be obvious, but is there a way to change the order of the variables as they appear in the graph generated by plot_profiles? The output I get always arranges them alphabetically, but there is a different order that would make it much more interpretable.

Thanks in advance for your advice!
Henriette

messages.author: f235054bd9ff417a
messages.subject: Re: Order of variables in plot_profiles
parts:
﻿Hi Henriette, the plot is created by ggplot2 and so ggplot2 functions (specifically scale_x_discrete(), I believe). Can you check out the answer to this question to see if it helps:

 

https://stackoverflow.com/questions/3253641/change-the-order-of-a-discrete-x-scale

 

Also, you can create your own plots using the data frame output—i.e., you can create a ggplot (or a plot with a different package, or even the base plotting functionality [though I would not recommend that 😊!]) from scratch.

Hope this helps.

Josh
